ruleDefinitions.name: Possible Impacket SecretDump Remote Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect AD credential dumping using impacket secretdump HKTL Note: Unmapped fields: ShareName, RelativeTargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ShareName = "\\\\\*\\ADMIN\$" AND (RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*SYSTEM32\\\\.*") AND RelativeTargetName = RGX(".*\\\.tmp.*")))
